chunks: Who then really shows you the way in the darkness of the desert and the sea? And who sends breezes bringing news of His benevolence? Is there any other god along with God? He is far too exalted for what they associate with Him!

key_terms.أَ إِلَٰهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ: is there a god with Allah
key_terms.ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ: darknesses of the land and the sea

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of Allah's power and mercy mentioned in Surah An-Naml regarding guidance and wind?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate Allah’s absolute sovereignty over both physical navigation and spiritual guidance, linking the 'darknesses' to the state of ignorance (Jahiliyyah) from which the Prophet led humanity. The mention of winds as 'heralds of mercy' underscores the divine preparation for rain, serving as a tangible sign of God's benevolence before the actual bestowal of grace. This reinforces the concept of Tawhid by contrasting the Creator’s active, purposeful control of nature with the passive, ineffective idols of the polytheists.
